notes.title: Patchnote 1.01 - Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello friends of our Fantasy Friends! We have an update for you !

A bug has been found that some of the players were stuck on launch screen. Our devs have worked on that point on it's now properly working!

Enjoy and sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Halloween Sale is Here! W've got some sweet underwater stuff for you...
notes.notes:
Ready to get scared... or not!

Halloween is the right time to enjoy some candies! Take care of your new friends in Fantasy Friends, and enjoy a lovely adventure among all the scary stuff around Halloween...

You really desserve a quiet place to chill out between two horror games sessions!

Fantasy Friends is now 50% OFF during the Halloween Steam Sale ! Grab it before it ends!

If you want to get even more sweeties... Please take a look at the first Fantasy Friends, who is currently 50% OFF !

notes.title: Discover the deep sea in Fantasy Friends: Under the Sea, out now !
notes.notes:
The deep sea is full of surprises... Just For Games and Xaloc Studios are pleased to share a brand new trailer for Fantasy Friends: Under the Sea, showcasing some of the animals and activities in the game! In the meantime, bubbles are sparkling because the game is releasing in just a couple of days... 

Fantasy Friends: Under The sea will be available on September 24th 2021 !
[previewyoutube=MtsXsD4iJXs;full][/previewyoutube]

Fantasy Friends: Under The Sea is the newest opus of the Fantasy Friends series. Discover a brand-new submarine world, with a lot of surprises, and 12 new underwater adorable friends to take care of! (Re)Encounter a very friendly mermaid, Aurea, who will guide you in this bubbly adventure!
